class.name: OcgPolyCoherentnode
class.brief_description: Node of coherent triangulation. Contains: Coordinates of a 3D point defining the node location 2D point coordinates List of triangles that use this Node Integer index, normally the index of the node in the original triangulation
class.description:
/** * Node of coherent triangulation. Contains: *
    *
  • Coordinates of a 3D point defining the node location
    • *
  • 2D point coordinates
    • *
  • List of triangles that use this Node
    • *
  • Integer index, normally the index of the node in the original * triangulation
    • *
*/

method.name: SetUV
method.description: Set the UV coordinates of the Node.

method.name: GetU
method.description: Get U coordinate of the Node.

method.name: GetV
method.description: Get V coordinate of the Node.

method.name: SetNormal
method.description: Define the normal vector in the Node.

method.name: GetNormal
method.description: Get the stored normal in the node.

method.name: SetIndex
method.description: Set the value of node Index.

method.name: GetIndex
method.description: Get the value of node Index.

method.name: IsFreeNode
method.description: Check if this is a free node, i.e., a node without a single incident triangle.

method.name: AddTriangle
method.description: Connect a triangle to this Node.

method.name: RemoveTriangle
method.description: Disconnect a triangle from this Node.
